title: Privacy-matched unequal Haar noise and adaptive clipping under non-IID federated learning
primary_hypothesis: Under identical user-level privacy accounting, sensitivity-aware unequal Haar coefficient noise plus privatized adaptive clipping improves non-IID test accuracy over the anchor paper's weighted-wavelet static-clipping mechanism.

privacy.accountant: RDP converted to epsilon at registered delta

claim_boundary: No privacy-utility claim is permitted unless all arms pass the matched-accountant audit. Gate 0 mechanism simulations are not empirical FL evidence.
